theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Technology (+1.25%) and Industrials (+1.07%) led the market today, while Utilities (-0.52%) and Health Care (-0.21%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +1.04%, defensives -0.20%, and value/cyclicals +0.65% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.86%, Dow +0.98%, Nasdaq +0.96% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at +0.45%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX fell 11.21% to 15.84, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 1.04% to $4,390.00, crude oil was little changed at $99.99, and bitcoin gained 0.68% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
